        """
        Compute all facet circumcenters and their angular radii.
        Returns: list of (radius_radians, circumcenter, simplex_indices)
        """
        try:
            hull = ConvexHull(pts)
        except Exception:

        results = []

            v1 = pts[simplex[0]]
            v2 = pts[simplex[1]]
            v3 = pts[simplex[2]]

            edge2 = v3 - v1
            n = np.cross(edge1, edge2)
